evidence: Changes wallet functional tests covering backup restoration across address types (wallet_keypool_topup.py) and wallet creation validation (wallet_createwallet.py).
rationale: Fixes testing bugs where backup and restore coverage for p2sh-segwit, bech32, and bech32m wallets was passing vacuously without replacing wallet files. While the wallet code itself is unchanged, correcting misleading tests ensures regression detection for keypool restoration and avoid_reuse behavior.
